data.name: Seeni
data.gender_notes: Seeni is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Seeni is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shuddh' which means pure. It is also associated with the lotus flower, a symbol of purity and spiritual growth. In Tamil and Telugu, Seeni is also the name of a Goddess who is worshipped as the embodiment of purity and grace. The name Seeni carries the meaning “Purity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu. Parents who choose Seeni usually hope their child will grow to embody purity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Seeni represents the inner purity and divinity that resides within each individual. It is a reminder to live a pure and virtuous life, and to cultivate inner peace and tranquility.
data.etymology: Seeni belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Purity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Seeni total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

Lotus flowers are frequently used in Hindu art, culture, and religious practices. The name Seeni may therefore be seen as reflecting the beautiful and elevated values of Hindu traditions.
